transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, honestly, the thing that kind of scared me into coming in is that my eating has just been completely all over the place lately. 

Like, some days I just forget meals entirely... I won't eat a thing. And then other nights, I'm just tearing through takeout and a bunch of snacks way after midnight. It's just really out of character and it kind of freaked me out.
Have you noticed any periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or wired, to the point where you didn't need much sleep?

Yeah, actually. Um, some mornings I wake up and I just feel... almost unbeatable, I guess. Like I have this huge rush of energy and I'm completely sure I can outsell everyone in my region. 

But it's kind of weird because when I'm feeling that wired, it doesn't take much to make me mad. Like, just one small comment from my manager or a client... it sets me off way more than it should. I just get really irritable out of nowhere.
When you have those periods of high energy and irritability, do they ever get so intense that you are unable to function at work or that people around you feel you need to go to the hospital?

Well, nobody has said anything about a hospital, but... yeah, it is definitely affecting my job. My manager actually started pulling me off some of my accounts recently. He said I'm making mistakes that I normally wouldn't make. And, um, HR even got involved after an employee-assistance call. 

I mean, I'm still showing up to the office every day, but... honestly, work and home both just feel like they're slipping out of my control right now.
During these periods when you feel unbeatable and wired, have you ever experienced things that others couldn't see or hear, or felt like you had special powers or abilities that aren't actually real?

Yeah, actually... I have. Um, it usually happens when I'm getting ready for my sales calls. I sometimes hear voices, and they sound as clear as if someone were standing right there in the kitchen with me. 

Sometimes they tell me I'm about to close every single account... and other times they're saying my boss is laughing at me. But yeah, it sounds totally real, even though nobody else is in the room.
Aside from these energetic periods, have you experienced times where you felt so low, hopeless, or empty that you lost interest in almost everything for weeks at a time?

Yeah, I have. Um, it's actually been happening a lot lately. I just... I don't really have the energy or desire to do much of anything anymore. 

Like, I used to play soccer on the weekends with some buddies, and I'd cook dinner for my girlfriend a lot. We even used to check out small art galleries downtown. I also used to like helping out the newer sales guys at work, giving them tips and stuff. But now... I just can't make myself care about any of it. I just feel really empty, like you said.
Are there ever periods of a few weeks or more where you are neither feeling that 'unbeatable' energy nor the deep, empty sadness, but you still hear those voices?

No, not really. The voices only started during that stretch when I was barely sleeping, talking nonstop, and feeling like I could take over every account. Before this whole blowup at work, I wasn't hearing things like that at all. It just seems to happen when I'm in that really high-energy state.
